answer: Because your car is registered in Texas, Texas's duplicate title rules apply, not Georgia's. Since the car is paid off, we need that duplicate title before we can complete the purchase, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes; the 2 to 3 week timeline in our articles applies only to Georgia duplicates. Please contact a store for Texas timing details.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
